decisions.disposition: FORENSIC_PREFIX_PASS_BOUNDED if integrity holds, otherwise NONQUAL_NOT_COMPLETED.
decisions.first_step_sufficiency: A prefix word is conditionally sufficient at the measured event when the matched readout is classified REVERSED by the frozen R122 classifier. Full trajectory causation cannot be deduced uniquely.
decisions.integrity: All 40 R124 events and H8/H20 R123 scores replay; exactly 38 H3, one H9 and one H11; source/protocol/frozen pins and budget gates pass; instrumented C bitwise equals original R119 on every probe; bounded R118 parity checks pass.
decisions.preclamp: Count actual raw per-instance, pre-reconciliation A/B proposal clamp activations. A positive clamp count indicates clamp use, but not causal responsibility for a sign reversal.

evidence_scope: Published R123/R124 events and seeds only; retrospective, no fresh held-out examples.
limitations: Retrospective, selection-biased sample of 40 failures, not prospective validation.
Context-dependent finite H1/H2 interventions do not uniquely identify the whole-trajectory cause.
Preclamp hit attribution only localizes saturation; causal effect of clamp requires its own intervention.
No production admission, no new learned policy, R93 hold remains.
preclamp_instrument: Diagnostic-only instrumented R119 C source is compiled exclusively in /dev/shm; count per live slot A/B un-clamped proposal norms whose exact clamp scale < 1, from native/K4 autonomous incoming states at H1,H2,H3; bitwise parity with unmodified R119 is mandatory. R119 original code and weights are never modified.
prefix_interventions: Complete 2^2 choices at steps H1,H2; N or K uniform intervening steps H3..H-1; either N or K at target horizon. Enumerate 8 paths for H3 and 16 for H9/H11; all original N^H and K^H endpoints must match native and K4 trajectories.
question: For each of 40 published R123 scale-4 K4-quarter induced readout reversals, which H1/H2 operator prefixes are conditionally sufficient to reproduce the event under fixed suffix contexts, and does actual preclamp proposal saturation occur in the first three recurrent updates?
